description: This file contains unit tests for atomic operations, including single-threaded and multi-threaded tests, using Google Test framework. It defines test classes, thread wrappers, and tests for atomic compare-and-swap, fetch-add, increment/decrement, and multi-threaded contention scenarios.

classes.name: TestThread
classes.description: Abstract base class for creating threads that run a custom Run() method, wrapping pthreads.

classes.name: CompareExchangeThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs compare_exchange_strong operations on an atomic variable, recording previous values.

classes.name: IncrementAndDecrementThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs a sequence of increment and decrement operations on an atomic variable.

classes.name: FetchAddSubThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs fetch_add or fetch_sub operations on an atomic variable.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Creates a pthread that runs the thread's Run() method.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins the pthread, waiting for thread completion.
